evidence_quotes.O: For years now, I've been looking for something that could offer a set-top box experience that was close to a good HTPC without actually being an HTPC.
evidence_quotes.C: My requirements were as follows:* It must protect the iPad from drops and impact.* It must have a latching top or zipper.
evidence_quotes.E: It's probably the best-feeling, best balanced, most responsive remote control I've ever owned. It has a great shape, and the back even has a nice grippy feel.
evidence_quotes.A: First of all, let's get the whining out of the way. No, there's no camera on this iPod touch.
evidence_quotes.N: While I'd simply loooooove to give you a more complete review by crashing my system and restoring from the Seagate Replica, I just can't work it out.
